falsifier: A guardian defect-log entry that sits in state DETECTED for more than one shift with no correction in flight and no protected-gate escalation on record — one such entry, verified in the log, falsifies compliance for that instance; a weekly gauge read whose escape latency is asserted rather than computed from log timestamps falsifies the measurement claim.
law: THE HOUSE-FIRE LAW — NAYA LAW, Shawn Vibert, Director, 2026-10-21 ~22:28Z (his direct words in chat)
owner: every seat (correction is owned by the seer); guardian + gauge instrumentation owned by the main seat

act.evidence: detection evidence is preserved and attached to the revert; the board is told; the tip/surface is verified after the revert
act.owner_rule: the first seat that proves the defect owns its correction; responsibility is everyone's, so permission is everyone's
act.report_only_violation: a report-only observation of a fixable defect is a protocol violation — noting-and-watching a known defect is itself the defect
act.revert_form: revert commit on main; never a history rewrite

escalation_exception.action: do not act alone — escalate to Shawn the same hour with the fix already scoped; the gate outranks the reflex

prevent.automation_owed_when: a failure class has occurred twice — an automation preventing or auto-correcting it is owed; hand-fixing that class a third time without the automation is the violation
prevent.watcher_rule: every critical mechanism must ship with a liveness watcher and an alarm path; a mechanism without a watcher is an unfinished build
watcher_specimens: post-merge guardian defect log (live/guardian-log branch, PR #2860)

speed.rule: correction never lowers Door A's bar and never slows Doors B/C; awareness instrumentation must not become a gate; slowing down is reserved for the Tier A consequence class
speed.source: Shawn, 2026-10-21 ~22:28Z — we never slow the system down to protect it; over-protection that stops the action is the failure mode

defect_classes: a merge that should not have landed
a live defect attributable to a landing
a blocked flow in a working path
a dead or silent critical mechanism
trigger.detection: continuous — the system is staffed 24/7; watchers, attributable test reds, live-surface probes, and seat/human reports all raise DETECTED

scoreboard: the Balanced Machine balance gauge (0033 section 6): post-merge escape rate + detection-to-correction latency, computed from the guardian defect log — never asserted
statement: If something lands that should not have, the seat that proves it puts it out in live time: revert first, diagnose second, fix forward third, automate the prevention fourth. Detection is continuous, correction is owned by the seer, speed is protected — slowing down is reserved for Tier A consequences.
title: THE HOUSE-FIRE LAW — ACTIVE INTELLIGENCE, AUTO-CORRECT IN LIVE TIME
